verification_environment.note: All tests in this verification suite were executed automatically against real dataset images (full-smear NIH-NLM microscope images and segmented single-cell RBC images) via the SmartCell HTTP API and pipeline; no physical USB microscope hardware was attached during this run.

root_cause_of_broken_annotated_image.root_cause_summary: 1) Domain/Mode Mismatch: C100P61ThinF_IMG_20150918_144104_cell_162.png (142x148 px) is an already-segmented single-cell RBC patch on a black background, not a multi-cell full blood smear. Stage 1 YOLOv8n produced 1 tiny 6x5 px artifact box (< 16 px min_box_size), leaving 0 valid RBC crops. 2) Hardcoded 4K Header Banner Occlusion & Unconditional 1920-px Upscaling: In run_smartcell_pipeline.py (create_annotated_full_image), cv2.rectangle(img, (20, 20), (2450, 210), (20, 20, 20), -1) drew a 2430x190 px near-black banner directly onto the 142x148 image—completely overwriting 85% of the cell from (20,20) to (142,148) with solid black (20,20,20), drawing giant clipped letters ('SMAR' / 'Valid R') across the remaining width, and unconditionally upscaling the occluded 142x148 image 13.5x to 1920x2001 px before embedding it in the PDF.
